The directory where the platform-specific binaries and libraries that Remotion needs are located. Those include an `ffmpeg` and `ffprobe` binary, a Rust binary for various tasks, and various shared libraries. If the value is set to `null`, which is the default, then the path of a platform-specific package located at `node_modules/@remotion/compositor-*` is selected.<br />This option is useful in environments where Remotion is not officially supported to run like bundled serverless functions or Electron.

## CLI flag

Use `--binaries-directory` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                                 | Flag                           |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)                   | `--binaries-directory <value>` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)                   | `--binaries-directory <value>` |
| [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)                     | `--binaries-directory <value>` |
| [`remotion compositions`](/docs/cli/compositions)       | `--binaries-directory <value>` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)             | `--binaries-directory <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)     | `--binaries-directory <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda still`](/docs/lambda/cli/still)       | `--binaries-directory <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render) | `--binaries-directory <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun still`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/still)   | `--binaries-directory <value>` |

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`combineChunks()`](/docs/renderer/combine-chunks#binariesdirectory)
- [`extractAudio()`](/docs/renderer/extract-audio#binariesdirectory)
- [`getCompositions()`](/docs/renderer/get-compositions#binariesdirectory)
- [`getSilentParts()`](/docs/renderer/get-silent-parts#binariesdirectory)
- [`getVideoMetadata()`](/docs/renderer/get-video-metadata#binariesdirectory)
- [`renderFrames()`](/docs/renderer/render-frames#binariesdirectory)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#binariesdirectory)
- [`renderStill()`](/docs/renderer/render-still#binariesdirectory)
- [`selectComposition()`](/docs/renderer/select-composition#binariesdirectory)
- [`stitchFramesToVideo()`](/docs/renderer/stitch-frames-to-video#binariesdirectory)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setBinariesDirectory('/path/to/custom/directory');
```
